seo.title: Thank you: guide request received
seo.description: Your request for a Calwebtech guide has been recorded. Here is what arrives in your inbox, and the sales sequence that does not.

title: Thanks. Your guide is on its way.
intro: Your request is recorded against the email address you gave. Asking for a guide does not sign you up to a sales sequence.

response.label: Your guide
response.detail: It comes from our own address. If it has not arrived within a few minutes, look in your spam or promotions folder.

steps.title: Check your inbox
steps.body: The email has a link to download the full guide, which you are welcome to share with your team.

steps.title: Ask about your own site
steps.body: If the guide raises a question about your website, send it through the contact page and a person will answer.

secondary.heading: Keep reading
secondary.body: Our published answers cover pricing, timelines, ownership and search visibility.

image.alt: A project team planning a website with sticky notes on a whiteboard
